transcript.text: Bit of a weird one - my son put the microwave on for 10 minutes with nothing in it by accident. Now there's a horrible smell. Is it broken?

⚠ Stop using this appliance
A burning or hot-plastic smell, smoke, scorching or melting can mean an electrical fault or a fire risk. Stop using it, switch it off and unplug it (or turn it off at the fuse box), and don't run it again — not even as a test — until it has been checked by a qualified engineer. I am sorry to hear that. Running a microwave empty for 10 minutes is very likely to have caused internal damage, such as arcing (sparking) which can burn the waveguide cover or even the magnetron itself. The 'horrible smell' suggests something has burnt inside. Because this involves high-voltage components and potential electrical faults, it is not safe for you to try to fix this yourself. Please unplug the appliance immediately and do not use it again until a qualified engineer has inspected it.

candidates: Internal damage from arcing (magnetron, waveguide cover, or high-voltage components) (high)

reading.symptom: horrible smell after running empty for 10 minutes

plan: They asked: "Is it broken?" - answer that first.

Safety: a burning hazard is active. The fixed safety warning is shown separately, do not repeat it. It must not be used again until a qualified engineer has checked it: say that plainly. You may explain the likely cause and suggest checks that are safe with it switched off and unplugged, but never say or imply that a check could make it safe to use, or that they might not need an engineer.
The fault they reported is: "horrible smell after running empty for 10 minutes". Keep to it: never describe a symptom, result or state they have not told you.

Stage 1 (broad help): say what could cause this, most likely first, as possibilities rather than certainties, including simple causes (settings, loading, detergent, installation, or normal behaviour) where they fit. Then give the one or two safe checks, or the one question, that would best tell those causes apart. Do not ask for the model number in this reply. Do not tell them to buy, order or replace a part yet.
